Your team's work,
in perfect sync.
Aurora is the shared workspace where docs, data and decisions stay live for everyone, everywhere, at 4ms. Stop exporting. Start pointing at the same thing.

Built for the speed
your team already moves at.
Every chart, doc and dashboard reads from the same live source. Refresh is not a concept here.
Presence, comments and edits merge in real time.
Everything in the UI exists in the API. In that order, tested.
Compliance page written by engineers, reviewed by lawyers, readable by humans.
“We deleted four internal tools the month we switched.”
“The 4ms thing sounded like marketing. It is not marketing.”
“Our Friday update writes itself now. Literally, it's an automation.”
“First tool where legal, finance and eng stopped exporting things at each other.”
“Onboarding was pasting one link into Slack.”
“I have not said 'can everyone see my screen' in six months.”

Get your team in sync
by this afternoon.
Free for teams up to 10. No credit card, no sales call, no 'quick sync' about sync.
